about_the_game:
"Wizavior" is a 3D platformer that will pull you into a whirlwind of adventure! The game offers two modes: Arcade and Story Mode. Arcade Mode will test your skills by constantly increasing the difficulty level as you progress, providing an intense and rewarding challenge. Meanwhile, Story Mode lets you step into the shoes of the titular Wizavior—a retired wizard who, with humor and determination, sets out once again to save the world from evil. The story mode also features an incredible narrative enriched with fully animated cutscenes and a progression system that allows you to follow the unfolding events and fully immerse yourself in the epic tale.

  • A single-player 3D platformer featuring a rich, story-driven experience brought to life with stunning 2D animations, visually breathtaking graphics, and a story with more than 30 minutes of interactive, fully animated cutscenes. 

  • A weird and quirky cast of characters to interact with, an interesting and funny protagonist, extraordinary humor, all wrapped up in a family-friendly experience.

  • A hub planet that evolves with your story progression, a scoreboard to track your best runs, and collectibles and achievements that extend beyond the main storyline. 

  • Two game modes—Story and Arcade—across 6 unique scenarios with multiple levels, offering a total of 33 distinct levels, a unique boss fight, and 5 special bonus levels!

  • Incredible soundtrack that enhances the overall experience. 

The game is a classic 3D platformer with a unique identity, filled with incredible humor and outstanding animations, offering a fantastic experience for players of all ages. Run, jump, and explore four diverse planets featuring 33 unique levels packed with challenges and unforgettable adventures.

The game offers two exciting modes: Story Mode, which provides a rich narrative full of twists and turns, interwoven with stunningly animated cutscenes, and a sense of progression with every completed mission; and replayable Arcade Mode, where the difficulty level increases as you progress. In this mode, you can hone your skills, improve your scores, and track your progress on the leaderboard.

Collect crystals scattered throughout the game and exchange them for a wide variety of rewards, including concept art, intricate statuettes, and many other unique items. These collectibles will not only enhance your in-game experience but also enrich your personal collection, offering you a deeper connection to the world and the characters within it. Each item serves as a memento of your journey, providing you with new ways to explore the game's artistry and lore.

At the end of the main storyline, you will encounter a unique and challenging boss, unlike any other foe you have faced. This intense battle will test everything you have learned, pushing your skills to the limit. Defeating this formidable adversary will not only give you the satisfaction of overcoming a major hurdle, but it will also unlock access to 5 extra levels.

Amazing audiovisual design that seamlessly blends stunning visuals and a dynamic soundtrack, enhancing your immersion in the magical world. Every environment and character are crafted in exquisite detail, while the soundtrack adapts to the story, deepening the emotional experience.
